How this compares in the UK

UK freelancers typically charge £500–£3,000 for a small business website and agencies £3,000–£10,000. A simple iPhone and Android app usually costs £8,000–£40,000. See our guide to small business website costs.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a website cost with ContentFellow?

One-off website builds start at £349 for Launch (up to 7 pages), £749 for Grow (up to 15 pages with blog and booking) and £1,499 for an online shop.

How much does an app cost?

Apps start at £1,249 for a web app, £3,499 for an iPhone and Android app with up to 10 screens, and from £6,499 for a custom app with backend and payments.

How do I pay?

Half when we start and half when your website or app goes live. The price is fixed before we begin.

What happens after launch?

You own the build. For hosting, security and changes, join the Build Fellow at £69 a month, or app care for apps.

How long does it take?

Launch sites usually go live in 1 to 2 weeks, Grow and Shop in 2 to 4 weeks, and apps in 3 to 8 weeks depending on the plan.
